capabilities: Renders CAS blobs inline from sha256 references
Accepts legacy cas:sha256 and blob://sha256 references
Shows unsupported or oversized blobs as a card
extras: Live Preview rendering is experimental and off by default; rendering toggles require reloading the plugin. The hash syntax identifies the expected blob but does not verify its digest; HTML renders as inert source, PDFs open in the browser viewer, and oversized blobs show a card.
motivation: Daily notes can reference the durable hash instead of keeping duplicate attachment files around.
problem: Obsidian cannot preview file payloads stored once in a content-addressed layout and referenced only by hash, so vaults keep duplicate attachment files.
summary: Read-only viewer that renders content-addressed vault blobs inline from durable sha256 references in embed and code-block syntax.
